technology_name: PCM-Integrated Solar Multi-Stage Interfacial Evaporation Desalination System
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Solar distillation units drop in performance significantly at night or under cloud cover due to the lack of an efficient, direct thermal storage backing.
description: A multi-stage interfacial evaporation assisted desalination (SMIED) assembly integrated with a phase change material (PCM) thermal storage unit, enclosed in non-reflective glass with automated capillary wicking channels.
applications: Off-grid coastal drinking water generators, remote island community desalination, portable disaster relief purification systems, and industrial wastewater recovery setups.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
